items.title: Joseph "Red" Clark Interview, 1959-11-11
items.q: That's right. That's Willie Pichaud. He'll tell you.

ctx.x: Would you say one or two a month or one a week?

A month? I saw myself when I played winning the record man. I played one every day. Or one solid week. I'll never forget that. Fellas would say man, they'd say man, man the way they passed in there, woo woo. We would get the shake out ourselves. One a day. I played three in a week. I have played two in a day. I played one ten in the morning and one morning in the evening. Two in the evening rather. That's right. That's Willie Pichaud. He'll tell you. But to say how many I played during my musical career, that's a…
What about now? How many do you play a month now you say?
